notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 2 will not be coming to Steam after all...
notes.content: [p]Some very sad news today. The second season of Tales From The Unending Void, which [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1224160/view/545604938652188730?l=english"]was planned for release this year[/url] has been rejected and banned by Steam after review. There are no appeals to this process, so I'm afraid this it the end of the franchise of three season on Steam. I'm looking at other storefronts like GOG to sell the second season.[/p][p][/p][p]Some background to the whole process: I first submitted the second season game build in early July. The game build was approved apart from some technical matters (a mature content overview that needed updating and missing controller support) on July 13. After fixing those issues and resubmitting I got the final review today telling me that Steam has decided not to publish the second season due to "themes, imagery or descriptions that we won’t distribute".[/p][p][/p][p]I can imagine that you have been looking forward to continuing the story of Camran and his crew. While the game won't be available on Steam, all of the game builds are cross-compatible. So if you download or buy the game elsewhere, you'll be able to continue where you've left off. When alternative options of purchasing the game become available I'll be sure to let you know.[/p]

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release this year!
notes.content:
[b]It's happening! [/b]

Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release here on Steam this year. The last episode of the season is currently in active development and once it's finished the entire season will be published on Steam.

Season Two picks up after the finale of the first season and you'll be able to continue the adventures of the Iron Bastard's crew. The second season contains episode 13 through 22 and includes bonus sex scenes, an updated walkthrough and extra artwork.

Please be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612990/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_2]wishlist the game[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612990/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_2

[b]Release Date[/b]
Once development of Episode 22 is finished and everything is ready to be published on Steam, I will announce the final release date of the second season.

[b]Separate game vs. DLC[/b]
The second season is a standalone game, but you'll be able to import your end-of-season season from Season One, which will carry over the choices you've made. Alternatively there's the option to fill out a short questionnaire where you'll be able to select the most important choices. Releasing the game as DLC is something I've investigated, but the technical implications of this scenario (maintaining localizations and code interoperability across versions) made me decide against going this route.

notes.title: The Music & Audio Update is here!
notes.content:
This update of Sisterly Lust has been in the works for quite a while now and I'm happy to be able to release for you all it today.

[h3]Music & Audio[/h3]
One of the most requested features in the game has been music and audio. The latest update of the game introduces music composed specifically for the game by a composer who wishes to remain anonymous.

In addition to music, ambient sound effects have been added throughout the game as well. Sex scenes have been upgraded with lewd effects (with the help of the amazing [url=https://opennsfw.carrd.co/]OpenNSFW Sound Pack[/url]) and voice acting by the inimitable [url=https://www.voicelikecandy.com/]VoiceLikeCandy[/url].

[h3]Lovense[/h3]
Sisterly Lust also features Lovense integration. So if you have a device, you can link it up with the game and get yourself stimulated with tailored patterns for your toy of choice. Read more about it [url=https://www.lovense.com/game/sisterly-lust]here[/url]. 

I have good news for you if you don't own a Lovense device, or if you're in the market for another toy. To celebrate the launch of this update, I've partnered up with Lovense and we're able to offer you a whopping 55% discount on any purchase made using [url=https://www.lovense.com/a/PerverteerGames]this affiliate link[/url].

[h3]Scene Gallery[/h3]
Sisterly Lust has lacked a scene gallery since its release and this update now includes one, as the code got an overhaul due to the inclusion of music and audio. You'll now be able to replay sex scenes you've encountered in your playthroughs and also be able to experience the variations of various scenes in case you've missed a narrative path.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Many of you have also requested a Chinese translation of the game and I have good news on that front as well. The new update also includes a Simplified Chinese translation by kittyr119!

Additional changes can be found in the changelog below.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season One will be released on May 2
notes.content:
A few days ago, I submitted Tales From The Unending Void for review her on Steam. Today I got the happy message that the game has been approved for sale.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858500/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_1/]The store page[/url] is now live and the game will release on May 2. I'd be honored if you spread the word and put the game on your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858500/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_1

Tales From The Unending Void is my next project after Sisterly Lust. While it shares many of the mechanics and kinks found in Sisterly Lust, my new game is set far into the future. 

[h2]Story[/h2]
Camran is a young minor noble from the Sovereignty, a part of space dominated by humans. Erstwhile cadet of the Terran Naval Academy, Cam has been forced by circumstances to travel the galaxy, together with a band of friends, taking on menial jobs and occasionally smuggling some illicit cargo. As he involuntarily becomes part of sinister plans machinated by powerful intrigants, Camran’s life is changed forever…

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Season One contains Episode 1 through 12 with two remaining seasons to be released as DLC
[*] Over 5000 renders
[*] Over 250 animations enhancing the many erotic scenes in the game
[*] Hours of branching story, offering replayability
[*] Rich and atmospheric soundtrack
[*] Scene replay for all sex scenes
[*] Codex detailing the various characters, species, planets and places in the game
[*] 60 achievements
[*] Official English Game guide (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[*] Bonus artwork featuring the many women in the game (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[/list]

notes.title: Allow me to tell you about a great game
notes.content:
Hey all,

As the Steam Autumn Sale has kicked off I'd like to tell you something about another game developer who had a big release here on Steam recently. I'm talking about ViNovella. Back in 2019 Vi reached out to me and we started talking about the game that would eventually become Fetish Locator. It has been a pleasure to see it take off after the initial release.

ViNovella released the first week of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360980/Fetish_Locator_Week_One__Extended_Edition/]Fetish Locator[/url] a couple of months ago and later extended it with sound effects and music. Vi's currently working on Week 2 which will be released on Steam as well as the second part of the trilogy. The game is centered around a mysterious app, called Fetish Locator, that's all the rage at the college the protagonist attends. The main character seizes the opportunity to explore his own sexual fetishes and get close to the girl of his dreams.

Fetish Locator: Week One is available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360980/Fetish_Locator_Week_One__Extended_Edition/]here on Steam[/url] and you can also play and support the development of the second week over at [url=https://www.patreon.com/fetishlocator]Patreon[/url].
